component.name: OpenPax
component.summary: Pax Imperia: Eminent Domain, rebuilt to run natively

description.p: OpenPax is a new engine for Pax Imperia: Eminent Domain, the 1997 space strategy game. It plays the game from your own copy (the GOG release) and ships none of its data: on first start it asks for your game folder or GOG's offline installer and imports what it needs.
